run_check_pipeline_typing: run the check_pipeline_typing CLI to detect inconsistencies in pipeline type hints
fix_pipeline_typing: fix pipeline type hint inconsistencies by running with --fix_and_overwrite flag
extract_pipeline_signature: extract the pipeline function signature from the Transformers pipelines __init__.py file
generate_overload_signatures: generate @overload decorated pipeline signatures for each supported task with Literal type hints
update_pipeline_file: update the pipeline file with new generated type hint code and write it back
